rows.reply: A fail-safe brake engages automatically when power or control signal is lost, so the system defaults to a safe, stopped state rather than moving freely.

rows.text: In one sentence, what is the point of a dead-man switch on a robot?
rows.reply: A dead-man switch ensures the robot only operates while a human actively holds the control, stopping motion immediately if the operator releases it or becomes incapacitated.
